profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
C/C++ Software Engineer, with a proven ability to plan, administer, coordinate, and execute full lifecycle Windows, Linux, Embedded based application design and development projects. Broad experience in C/C++ software programming and development, management, installation, maintenance, administration, security, troubleshooting and technical support. Knowledge of diverse programming languages, architectures, and platforms, with the ability to apply expertise in the successful completion of IT projects. Outstanding ability to gather and translate complex client requirements into practical, reliable, cost-effective software and system solutions. Proactive problem solver, developing software solutions with careful consideration to bottom-line, long-range goals, quality, feasibility, and ease of use.

Full Lifecycle C/C++Development • Programming • Troubleshooting & Application Development • Automotive Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Own project-level development of security features for Futurex HSM and vHSM platforms, from technical design through implementation, testing, and delivery. Work primarily in C/C++ on Linux, with a focus on cryptographic services, identity management, PKI, mTLS authorization, and external identity provider integration. Collaborate across firmware, frontend, QA, and product teams to deliver secure, production-ready solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Bring up project Metadefender Kiosk Linux from concept through commercial releases. Owner
of various back-end key features such as Licensing, Firmware updates, Engine updates,
Scanning, and communication with the Central Management server... Customize homemade
OPSWAT Linux-based distro as per project requirements. Handle full lifecycle of CI/CD on
TeamCity from detecting newly merged commits to output deb, firmware, upgrade package,
OVA, etc, ... Made scripts to fully set up the development environment from a fresh system.
Mentoring new team members working with several R&D tasks.
Part of initial release for project Metadefender Firewall for LED manager, Firmware upgrades, ...

Key Achievements:
★ Successfully released Metadefender Kiosk and Metadefender Firewall
★ Contributed to mostly all aspects of the project that can be reused/ extended by future
projects
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · C++ · Docker · Shell Scripting

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on MetaDefender Drive project which provides a device analysis solution in a storage
device form factor (USB) under a parallel environment that embeds multiple anti-malware
engines and OPSWAT vulnerability detection, Data Loss Prevention capabilities. Responsible for
multiple features under a Linux-based environment such as Internet handling, Engine updating,
Boot into live USB without BIOS, supports detecting and decrypting drives encrypted by
BitLocker/ LUKS/ TrueCrypt, ... Actively corporate and support teammates from both Vietnam
and U.S. daily.

Key Achievements:
★ The team brought up the live USB from scratch to be a commercial product.
★ Be honored for outstanding performance over the Year 2019.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · C++ · Docker · Shell Scripting

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
One of the first three members to start this project to bring up the whole applications/
services of Vehicle Microcontroller (VUC) into the new Telematics Platform. This came with an
outstanding result, bringing the opportunity to expand Vietnam's team size from three to ten
members. In the next phase, keep working on various modules: Audio, Communication Box,
Record of Behavior, Vehicle Probe, IPC, Diagnostic, CAN… Analyzed requirements, designed at
black box/ white box level, coded in C language, and conducted testing for all working modules
with high quality that satisfied the ASPICE audit yearly. Mentoring new members so they can
quickly understand and adapt to project requirements.

Key Achievements:
★	Successfully delivered development product with high commitment and quality got high credit from customer, expanded Vietnam team from 3 developers to 10 developers.
★	Achieved exemplary customer satisfaction survey scores of up to 92/100.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Embedded Systems · Automotive

positions.title: Software Integrator, Automation Test Lead
positions.description:
Played key role in the 20-members global team tasked with developing and testing Connectivity and Audio modules for Continental Automotive Singapore. Served as Software Integrator, Automation Test Lead, responsible for the full lifecycle of software delivery, testing, and integration. On-time recovered all the automation test scripts for Connectivity modules so the team could pass the testing audit. Led five-members team in Vietnam in Audio manual and automation testing. Reported to senior management and project stakeholders. Creatively made the script to test audio frequency so that it could cover all the audio test cases. Mentored team members on all the aspects of the integration process, manual and automation testing.

Key Achievements:
★	Successfully deployed the Software Integration process from Singapore to Vietnam, which no one believed could thus reduce the cost for the project.
★	Opened a new team in Vietnam with 6 members to handle the entire integration and automation testing of the Audio domain.
★	Received top 100 superior performance awards (over 10,000 employees) for FPT-Software in 2016.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Coordinated with the 30-member global team in the development of HMI (Human Machine Interface) for the automotive industry. Developed HMI components based on HMCDIS2 Core with production quality according to automotive industry standards while adding new features required by customers. Optimized, troubleshoot, and resolve issues with existing modules.

Key Achievements:
★	Quickly learning and exploring project technical, one of the most supportive person in the team.
★	Successfully developed HMI Module Tuner (Weather/ Traffic/ Sport/ Safe View) in C++.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Assisted in developing medical information systems in C#/ C++ (front-end and back-end applications for MRI machines). Created new and additional functionality of existing source code according to customer requirements and improved performance by refactoring source code. Led project teams and supported team members to ensure successful completion. Played a key role in coding, unit testing, and integration testing.

Key Achievements:
★	I got very high credit from the customer for the pilot period, thus got the contract to expand the team from 2 members to 7 members.
★	Increased the performance up to 23%, reducing body scanning time, and the hospital could serve more patients.
★	Consistently achieved exemplary customer satisfaction survey scores of up to 99/100.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Higher Diploma in Software Engineering, 2010- FPT APTECH, Information Technology

honors.title: Star Performer
honors.description: Employee of the year award - Honoring outstanding performance over the Year 2019.
